# Boomi Documentation — Full Markdown Index

> Official documentation for the Boomi Enterprise Platform — integration, API management, AI agents, data hub, flow automation, and more

## Notes for AI tools

This index lists every documentation page as a clean .md file — full content, no HTML, no JavaScript, no navigation markup.

Each .md file includes YAML frontmatter with:
- `url` — URL of this .md file
- `doc_id` — stable GUID identifier (where available)
- `canonical_html_url` — human-readable HTML page URL
- `last_updated` — ISO date of last content change (from git history)
- `page_type` — concept | task | reference | landing | blog | release_notes
- `description` — one-line summary of the page (where available)

Each index entry below is formatted as: `- [Title](md_url) (page_type): description | last_updated: date`

URL pattern: `https://help.boomi.com/md/docs/Atomsphere/{Section}/{page}.md`
